fw_home_b_mum.text: Telford's Neptune's Staircase is a ladder of eight locks at Banavie. A boat takes about ninety minutes to climb it.
The Jacobite steam train crosses the Glenfinnan viaduct. Your friends will say it is from a famous wizard film. They will be right.

then.text: I gave you a piece already. You have been very polite, so you may stay for tea.

else.text: Here, a bit of tablet for the road. Please do not tell the dentist.
